shots.composition_other: Browser-less app window anchored top-left, cropped off the top and right edges, floating over a white backdrop with a large blue curved swoosh in the bottom-left corner; the report table occupies the upper-left third.
shots.focal_element: Actuals Import Check report table (Jan-Apr 2021 columns, Revenue to Net Income rows), with an orange highlight box on the Apr 2021 column.

shots.typography: Native app UI typography: small sans-serif (Roboto/Helvetica-like, low-confidence guess), regular weight for labels, bold for P&L row labels and the white-on-blue month header row, sentence/title case, default tracking; figures are tabular numerals right-aligned. No added motion-graphic titles.
shots.what_happens: Opens on the tail of the integration task page (too small to read), a loading spinner shows on a blank page, then the Actuals Import Check report loads with four months of figures; an orange rectangular callout outlines the Apr 2021 column for roughly two seconds (around w159-w164, 'loads it into the Workday Adaptive Planning Actuals data set') then disappears; the view holds static while VO says the April actuals are loaded (w165-w176), and at the end the cursor moves to the logo and the navigation menu starts to open.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a real screen capture of the report inside a drop-shadowed window offset to bleed off the top-right of a 1920x1080 white canvas with a blue corner swoosh, then animate an orange 2px stroke rectangle around the Apr 2021 column (fade in, hold ~2 s, fade out) synced to the VO phrase about loading actuals.

shots.composition_other: Same top-left-anchored cropped window over the blue-swoosh backdrop; a two-column navigation flyout fills the left side while the rest of the app is dimmed to near black.
shots.focal_element: Blue left navigation menu and white Reports submenu with the cursor travelling down from Reports to Modeling.
shots.transition_other: In-app state change: the navigation flyout opens over the report and the page behind darkens, rather than an editorial cut.

shots.what_happens: Live navigation: the menu is open with Reports expanded and Actuals Import Check highlighted; the cursor moves down the blue nav from Reports past Dashboards and Formulas to hover Modeling, over VO 'quickly create as many forecast versions' (w181-w186).
shots.build_rebuild: Show a screen capture of the app nav flyout in the same offset window and let the recorded cursor glide from 'Reports' to 'Modeling' over ~2 s, keeping the backdrop dimmed so the menu reads as the only bright element.

shots.composition_other: Window still cropped off the right edge over the blue swoosh, slightly larger and lower than in s013; card grid in the upper-left.

shots.typography: Native app UI: bold sans-serif card titles in title case under black glyph icons, small bold blue link text for sub-items, default tracking.
shots.what_happens: A ~0.25 s flash frame of the Model Management page loading, likely the first frames of the page before the zoom/reframe into s013; cursor rests near the Others card (VO word w187 'and').
